_comment: Corrections to what the filename matcher worked out about a photograph. Everything else in the archive is derived from a filename by a machine; this file is the one place a person overrules it, and the only place a claim about a photograph may be entered by hand. Each correction records who made it, so a doubtful one can be asked about. Applied by `npm run archive:index`.

station-en-omgeving-station-eerste-stoom.title: Praalwagen 'de eerste stoomtrein van 1854' - Onafhankelijkheidsfeesten
station-en-omgeving-station-eerste-stoom.note: Not a photograph of 1854: the 'locomotive' is a parade float drawn by horses, past a beenhouwer's shopfront - the Onafhankelijkheidsfeesten float of 1905 depicting the first train of 1854. Same event as '75 jaar Belgie - Onafhankelijkheidsfeesten - eerste trein Kapellen 1854'. The title is rewritten as well as the year: a card reading "eerste stoomtrein Kapellen 1854" above the year 1905 reads as a mistake, and this photograph has now been reported as misdated twice by people who were reading exactly that.

feesten-in-kapellen-75-jaar-belgie-onafh.title: 75 jaar Belgie - Onafhankelijkheidsfeesten - praalwagen 'de eerste trein van 1854'
feesten-in-kapellen-75-jaar-belgie-onafh.note: The same float as 'Station - eerste stoomtrein Kapellen 1854', and the same 1905 celebration of 75 years of Belgian independence. Retitled for the same reason: the 1854 in the name is what the float depicts, not when the photograph was taken.

gemeentepark-beaulieu-het-klein-bos-23-v.note: Number 23 of Vicky Staal's 'Het Klein Bos 1-36' series; every other number sits in the Klein Bos folder. Het Klein Bos lies between Wilgenstraat, Knotwilgstraat and Akkerstraat, 900 m from the Gemeentepark Beaulieu - the two do not adjoin, so the park tag from the folder is wrong.

gemeentepark-beaulieu-ertbrandbos-2-gaby.note: The filename says Ertbrandbos, which lies next to the Fort van Ertbrand, 4.5 km north of the Gemeentepark Beaulieu. Filed in the wrong folder; the park tag comes from the folder, not the photograph.

station-en-omgeving-station-en-nieuwstra.note: Filed under "Nieuwstraat", which is a Stabroek street; Kapellen's Nieuwstraat is today the Lucien Bevernagestraat. The building in the postcard is Rubensheide 144, which fits the numbering on legacy-site/Rubensheide.htm (55, 120, 132, 134, 136, 142).
